name: Leap: A Dragon's Adventure
summary: Leap: A Dragon's Adventure is a 3D platformer featuring a one-button dash and "flappy" flight mechanics. Players control a customizable dragon across various themed worlds, such as a frozen tundra and a Japanese-inspired landscape, each introducing new environmental obstacles. Success relies on managing a stamina bar and flying through hoops to recover energy. The game features local and global leaderboards, achievement-based unlocks, and a daily item store.
